children: Video-game retailer GameStop Corp. (GME, Financials) anticipates second-quarter net income of $290 million to $310 million, a dramatic increase from $168.6 million a year earlier.

The headline profit did, nonetheless, come with a crucial caveat. GameStop said net gains from conversion of an eBay derivative asset into a direct equity investment of 43.4 million shares, worth about $4.95 billion, totaled approximately $238 million.
That gain offset a $75 million loss on electronic assets and related receivables. The retail business below remains under pressure.

Net sales are likely to decline to a range of $780 million to $800 million from $972.2 million in the same period last year, amid store closures, the sale of its France operations and a tough comparison with the Nintendo Switch 2 launch.

Operating income is estimated to be $150 million to $170 million, compared to $66.4 million last year. Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities are estimated at about $5.05 billion to $5.07 billion, down from $8.69 billion as GameStop put funds into the eBay position.
The next test is Sept. 8, when GameStop announces full results and investors get a deeper look at how much of the earnings rise came from the core company versus investment gains.

title: GameStop's $300 Million Profit Has a $238 Million Catch
